entries.title: Yellow flags on the lap chart: every full-course caution as a faint yellow band behind the field's lines, so you can see why the order shuffles where it does

values.label: on (default): a yellow wash from the lap the caution came out to its last lap under yellow, a flag tab above the chart, a hairline where the field went green
off: the lap chart as it was

entries.look: Any INDY NXT race page → The race, lap by lap. Detroit 2024 has four cautions (14 of 45 laps under yellow). Point at a yellow tab (or tap it) to read the caution: its cause, its laps, the restart lap. Hover a line inside a band and the card says 'under yellow'.

entries.title: Flights arc, drives stay on the ground: on the travel map, legs the rule of thumb calls a flight lift off the globe with a faint dashed ground shadow; drives are drawn flat

values.label: arc (default): drives flat on the globe, flights lifted with their ground track as a dashed shadow; the leg readout says 'a drive' or 'a flight'
off: every leg lifts a little by its length, as before

entries.look: Career → The travel map. Watch the journey play: the Atlantic crossings and the West Coast trips rise; the UK and Midwest hops stay on the ground. The readout under the big figure says which each leg is.

entries.title: Rain on the race marks: a wet race's dot gets short rain streaks (three for wet, two fainter for damp or drying) on the INDY NXT season charts, the earlier seasons' charts and the 'His … races' chart on each race page; the card says 'wet track', with '(modelled)' when the call comes from the weather model

values.label: on (default): streaks in the rain dive's blue
ink: the same streaks in grey, so they never sit near a series colour (Formula Ford's navy is close to the rain blue)
off: no marks; cards fall back to the old wet/dry words

entries.look: Races → 2026 (Indianapolis Race 1 and World Wide Technology Raceway, both modelled wet) and 2020 (10 of 24 Formula Ford races wet or damp, from the official TSL reports). Also /career/race/session_gb3_2021_212905_race_1_result → His GB3 races. Point at (or tap) a streaked dot.

entries.title: The field's floor on each INDY NXT season chart: a short dash per round at last place in that day's field, so P20 of 21 and P20 of 24 read apart

values.label: on (default): a quiet dash at each round's field size; the hovered round's dash darkens; the axis runs to the biggest field

entries.look: Races → 2024 season: the field shrinks from 21 cars to 18–19 mid-season, so his P19 at St. Petersburg sits on the floor. 2026: 24 cars almost every round, so his P22 and P23 sit just above it.
